highlights: Alternate smooth: let go of Shift mid-stroke to smooth without losing volume, as in ZBrush
Masking: Ctrl+drag draws a mask rectangle, Lasso and Rectangle follow symmetry, a click blurs the mask
Pen tablets in mouse mode no longer jump; click the axis gizmo to snap views; Part thumbnails
SculptForge stays free: Help > Support SculptForge if you'd like to back it (Insiders get releases early)
